title: LuaJIT is not available in this repo, so src/lua executes no scripts (LUA-01..16 downgraded to IN_PROGRESS)
notes:
Discovered while resolving ISS-0153 / GH #471 (repairing src/lua's Zig 0.16 rot and wiring it into the build graph).

ISS-0153 fixed the compile rot and made src/lua type-checked on every `zig build test` (new target `zig build test-lua`, root src/lua_test_root.zig). It did NOT make Lua work, because LuaJIT is simply not present in this repository. That half of the acceptance criteria is this issue.

EVIDENCE THAT LUAJIT IS UNAVAILABLE (all verified empirically on 2026-08-06, not assumed):
- `zig test` on a probe containing only `@cInclude("lua.h")` fails with `'lua.h' not found`, both with and without `-lc`.
- `zig test -lc -lluajit-5.1 <probe>` fails with `unable to find dynamic system library 'luajit-5.1' using strategy 'paths_first'. searched paths: none`.
- `find . -name lua.h -o -name luajit.h -o -name 'libluajit*'` returns nothing.
- vendor/ contains only pg, http, cel. build.zig.zon .dependencies contains only pg, http, cel.
- No LuaJIT install step in docker-compose.yml or .github/workflows/.

CURRENT STATE AFTER ISS-0153:
src/lua/luajit_bindings.zig was converted from an unresolvable `@cImport` + `pub extern fn lua_*` surface to pure-Zig `inline fn` stubs (the same disposition ISS-0147 applied to src/wasm/wasmtime_bindings.zig). The stubs deliberately return FAILURE sentinels rather than success -- lua_newstate -> null, luaL_loadstring -> LUA_ERRSYNTAX, lua_pcall -> LUA_ERRRUN -- so executor.executeScript reports an error instead of silently pretending a script ran. `luajit_bindings.has_real_luajit` is a public `false` constant that tests assert against, so this cannot drift unnoticed.

CONSEQUENCE: LUA-01..16 (16 MUST requirements) were downgraded RELEASED -> IN_PROGRESS under ISS-0153, because RELEASED was not backed by anything executable. They cannot honestly return to RELEASED until this issue is resolved.

NOTE ON LUA-04 SPECIFICALLY: the bytecode-magic rejection in executor.zig is genuine pure-Zig logic and IS covered by a passing test today. It was still downgraded because LUA-04's defence-in-depth also depends on stdlib.zig stripping load/loadstring/string.dump from a real interpreter, which currently runs against stubs and is unverified.
candidate_resolution:
Make a real LuaJIT available and swap the stubs for real bindings:
(a) Vendor LuaJIT under vendor/luajit (matching the existing vendor/pg, vendor/http, vendor/cel pattern) or add it as a build.zig.zon dependency, building the static archive from source so linking stays static per LUA-01's explicit requirement.
(b) Replace the stub section of src/lua/luajit_bindings.zig with the real `@cImport` of lua.h/lualib.h/lauxlib.h/luajit.h plus `pub extern fn` declarations. The stub signatures were deliberately kept faithful to the LuaJIT 2.1 (Lua 5.1) ABI so this is a drop-in replacement, not a rewrite of call sites. Flip `has_real_luajit` to true.
(c) Link the archive into the `lua` build module in build.zig (linkLibrary/addObjectFile alongside the existing link_libc = true).
(d) Write the real execution tests that tests/specs/LUA-01-05.md already specifies (~40 cases) and that docs/issue-reports/MINOR-LUA-001-resolution.md deferred in May 2026 for exactly this reason -- note that document already predicted this blocker and named 'add luajit.h to build environment' as the trigger.
(e) Only then restore LUA-01..16 to RELEASED, per requirement, with test evidence.

Until (a)-(d) are done, the honest status is IN_PROGRESS and the stubs must keep returning failure sentinels -- a stub that returns success would be the silent-false-negative anti-pattern (ISS-0155).
